title: Dialog frame and actions
guidance: Use declarative titles, bounded responsive width and visible mobile gutters. Keep copy short and actions in one clear hierarchy. Review child details, the frame and page context together. Overflow must not hide the title or actions.

Latest human direction: content-origin dialogs/popovers dim and blur the backdrop consistently, with opaque reduced-transparency fallback. Layout-origin menus retain attached behavior without backdrop blur. Close X is borderless at rest. Remove duplicate pending-dismiss actions when X has identical behavior; keep dismissal escapable and background operation state intact.

Safe alternatives Keep job / Keep In Progress must have a visible outline/fill and precede the critical confirmation; confirmation remains bottom on stacked mobile. Got it stays quiet with text-only hover.

decisions.title: Bounded dialog with mobile gutters
decisions.reason: Use the same28rem maximum and at least16px side gutters. Close stays reachable; long content scrolls inside the dialog.

decisions.title: Declarative title and compact meaningful content
decisions.reason: Start job / Complete job / Cancel job / Requirements incomplete replace question-like headings and repeated prose. Keep job identity, price where relevant, irreversible consequence and specific blockers.

decisions.title: Clear actions and keyboard control
decisions.reason: One primary operation or recovery route, a quieter dismissal, visible focus, Escape/outside dismissal, focus trap and trigger restoration. Narrow200% headings get a full-width row below a compact Close control.

decisions.title: 1.8 content dialog atom and overlay
decisions.reason: Content dialogs share cu-content-dialog, closeControl and backdrop tokens. One X while pending, with no redundant identical Continue browsing. Programmatic title focus outlines the panel, not a text-tight browser rectangle. Controls keep visible keyboard focus. Layout header menus keep attached behavior.

parameters.name: Frame
parameters.description: Width min(viewport minus2×clamp(16px,5vw,32px),28rem); max-height viewport minus2rem; body padding1–1.5rem; narrow enlarged Close target48px.

parameters.name: Focus
parameters.description: Ordinary dialogs start on the safe footer dismissal; overflowing/pending dialogs focus the visible title.

parameters.name: Backdrop
parameters.description: 6px blur and .46 scrim proposal; reduced-transparency uses an opaque darker scrim with blur removed. Native anchored pickers keep their existing shadow, not modal behavior.
